seo.title: Privacy Manifesto | SafeTools - Zero Data Policy
seo.description: Our Privacy Manifesto: SafeTools never collects, stores, or transmits your files. All processing is 100% local and browser-based.
seo.keywords: privacy policy, zero data collection, local processing privacy, safe tools privacy, browser security manifesto
seo.ogDescription: Your data stays on your device. Always.

hero.title: Privacy is Sovereign.
hero.subtitle: SafeTools is a zero-server privacy ecosystem designed to return full digital control to the user.

pillars.title: Air-Gapped Design
pillars.desc: Logic runs entirely in the browser. No data ever crosses the network boundary.

pillars.title: Zero Persistent State
pillars.desc: We don't use cookies, databases, or local storage for your sensitive data.

pillars.title: Open Architecture
pillars.desc: Every tool is built with transparent web standards that you can audit yourself.

verification.title: Don't Trust. Verify.
verification.subtitle: We believe in radical transparency. Here is how you can prove our privacy claims in 10 seconds.

steps.title: Open DevTools
steps.desc: Right-click anywhere on the page and select 'Inspect' or press F12.

steps.title: Toggle Network Tab
steps.desc: Switch to the 'Network' tab to monitor all outgoing traffic.

steps.title: Execute Any Tool
steps.desc: Upload a file or encrypt a note. You will see zero network requests being sent.

items.title: Zero Server Knowledge
items.desc: We don't just 'encrypt' your files; we never see them. Our servers only serve static code. Your data stays in your RAM, exactly where it belongs.

items.title: No Surveillance Capitalism
items.desc: We use no analytics, no cookies, and no trackers. We don't want to know who you are, where you are, or what you're processing.

items.title: Ephemeral by Default
items.desc: Your data is processed in volatile memory. Once you close the tab, the state is wiped. There are no backups, because there is no storage.

items.title: Verified Isolation
items.desc: SafeTools uses the highest browser security headers (COOP/COEP) to ensure that your processing session is strictly isolated from other web content.

protection.title: Protected Data Streams
protection.subtitle: Your sensitive information is always handled with industrial-grade local isolation.

final.title:
Ready to Reclaim

Your Digital Rights?
final.subtitle: Join thousands of users who trust SafeTools for their most sensitive operations.

privacy.title: गोपनीयता नीति

sections.title: डेटा प्रोसेसिंग
sections.content: हमारी अधिकांश सेवाएं आपकी फ़ाइलों को आपके डिवाइस पर स्थानीय रूप से (locally) प्रोसेस करती हैं। इसका मतलब है कि आपकी फ़ाइलें कभी भी हमारे सर्वर पर अपलोड नहीं की जाती हैं।

sections.title: कोई ट्रैकिंग नहीं
sections.content: हम उपयोगकर्ताओं की व्यक्तिगत जानकारी ट्रैक नहीं करते हैं। हम विज्ञापन दिखाने के लिए न्यूनतम कुकीज़ का उपयोग कर सकते हैं, लेकिन हम कभी भी आपकी फ़ाइलों की सामग्री का विश्लेषण नहीं करते हैं।

sections.title: डेटा सुरक्षा
sections.content: क्योंकि डेटा आपके डिवाइस को नहीं छोड़ता है, इसलिए ट्रांजिट में डेटा चोरी होने का जोखिम समाप्त हो जाता है।

audit.title: Network Audit Verified
audit.description: Open your browser Developer Tools (F12) and check the Network tab. You will see zero outbound data transfers during tool usage.

privacy.introduction: SafeTools में, आपकी गोपनीयता हमारी सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता है। यह नीति बताती है कि हम आपके डेटा को कैसे सुरक्षित रखते हैं और हमारा प्लेटफॉर्म क्लाइंट-साइड प्रोसेसिंग का उपयोग क्यों करता है।
